s.note: Frankfurts on sticks in a sweet polenta and buttermilk batter, fried golden, with American mustard and tomato sauce
s.how: Whisk 150g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt, then whisk in 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk to a thick batter and pour into a tall glass. Heat 1.5 litres oil to 175C in a deep pot. Pat 8 frankfurts dry and push a bamboo skewer into each. Dip in the batter, twirl to coat and fry 2 at a time for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve hot with mustard and tomato sauce.

s.note: Thick slices of green tomato in a crisp polenta and flour crust, fried golden, with a spicy buttermilk and chive dressing
s.how: Slice 4 large green tomatoes 1cm thick, salt lightly and sit on paper towel for 15 minutes. Set out a bowl of 75g flour, a bowl of 2 eggs beaten with 60ml buttermilk and a bowl of 100g fine polenta mixed with 1/2 tsp cayenne and 1/2 tsp salt. Dip each slice in flour, egg and polenta. Shallow-fry in 1cm of oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and drain. Stir 125ml buttermilk with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives, a dash of hot sauce and pepper and serve with the hot tomatoes.

m.n: Beale Street dry rub pork ribs with slaw
m.note: Pork ribs in a smoky paprika, brown sugar and garlic dry rub, slow-baked and mopped with vinegar, with creamy slaw and white bread
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp sweet paprika, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp each garlic and onion powder, 1 tsp each cayenne, thyme and pepper and 2 tsp salt. Rub all over 2kg American-style pork ribs and leave 1 hour in the fridge. Wrap tightly in foil on a tray and bake at 150C for 2 1/2 hours. Unwrap, turn the oven to 220C, splash with 60ml cider vinegar, dust with a little more rub and roast 15 minutes until crusted. Toss shredded green and red cabbage and 2 grated carrots with 100g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tsp sugar. Cut the ribs and serve with the slaw and white bread.

w.n: Graceland fried peanut butter and banana sandwiches
w.note: Peanut butter and mashed ripe banana in white bread, fried golden in butter, with a drizzle of honey and a dusting of icing sugar
w.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas. Spread 8 slices of white bread with 160g smooth peanut butter and spread the banana over 4 of them, then sandwich together. Melt 40g butter in a large frying pan over medium heat and fry the sandwiches 2 at a time for 3 minutes a side, pressing with a spatula, until deep golden, adding more butter for the second batch. Cut into fingers, drizzle with honey and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Strong black tea sweetened while hot, chilled with fresh peach syrup and lemon, poured over ice with mint
d.how: Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 120g sugar and 250ml water for 8 minutes, then mash and strain. Pour 1 litre boiling water over 6 black tea bags, steep 5 minutes and remove. Stir in the peach syrup and the juice of 1 lemon, add 500ml cold water and chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice with peach slices, lemon and mint.
